caseDefinition.steps: While a mode switch waits for the current save, switch tabs or replace the active save.
caseDefinition.expected: Cancel the old switch request; an old Promise must not change the new mode/file or publish a stale mode-switch error.

scenarios: Current unchanged intent: real successful save changes mode; real native precommit conflict retains mode and rejects.
Navigation to B or away/back to A while saving: old success incorrectly changes A mode; old conflict incorrectly rejects the obsolete mode request.
New explicit request to remain document is overwritten by the older source-mode request.
Replacing the awaited operation with another real save while local remains dirty is already guarded.

activeSaveRefinement.scenario: After First is saved, begin a second real native save of Second, then return local input to current base First while the new save remains pending. The old mode-switch continuation sees dirty=false and incorrectly changes to source despite the active-save replacement.
activeSaveRefinement.observed: Disk First/local First/dirty=false while second save is gated; after actual second write disk Second/local First/dirty=true. Both native writes return saved; no fake successful save receipt.

U.scope: Production FileWorkspaceStore request/selection/mode guards with controlled timing.

I.chain: Production store -> FileBuffer -> FileService/recovery -> packaged native broker -> independent file reads; gate delays actual native save dispatch, which executes normally after release.

plan: After root releases the r5 source freeze, add a mode-request generation captured with the tab/buffer, selected intent, initial mode and input version. Recheck cancellation before reporting save failure or changing mode; a new explicit same-mode request invalidates older work. Do not cancel already-started actual writes. Also reject continuation while a replacement save is active.
boundaries: Only temporary isolated Markdown fixtures were edited; no actual App UI, user project, model or external service was used.
Production src/prototype/dependencies remain unchanged during r5 freeze.

The prototype mode-save path currently commits synchronously and has no delayed-save response boundary. No new UI layout is needed for the production request guard; asynchronous cancellation evidence belongs to U/I.
R4 provides only native broker executable; current workspace store/buffer under test include later input-safety changes.
No formal pass is claimed until the real failed cases and related regression are rerun after the fix.
